description: Product Name: Power BI Calendar Visualization Objects Version: 1.0.0 Release Date: December 31, 2024 Developed by: [Infortime 时勤] Key Features: Data-driven visualization: Users can directly drive the calendar through Power BI's data model for dynamic data presentation. Highly customizable: Provides a variety of customization options, including colors, fonts, legend positions, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as clicking and hovering to enhance the user experience. Responsive Design: The calendar can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. Multi-language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Data point highlighting: Users can specify data points to be highlighted for specific dates, making it easy to identify key events or data. Time Range Selection: Users can customize the time range displayed, such as monthly view, weekly view, or a specific date range. Event Integration: Allows users to integrate event data into the calendar to display event details and times. Calendar Type Switching: Supports various calendar types such as Gregorian and Lunar calendars to meet the needs of different cultural backgrounds.
